messages:
elena: Noticed a weird divergence after route-policy v3 went live: rollup p99 for /v1/chat/completions jumped ~35% but the endpoint breakdown per-host doesn't show that tail. anyone else seeing mismatch?

jordan: saw the alert. p50/p95 steady, p99 alone moved. could be a merge/weighting issue with tdigest from multiple collectors.

priya: do we have different sampling configs at collector vs aggregator? last rollout changed default ingress sample_rate for low-tier to 0.15.

metrics-bot: rollout "route-policy-v3" deployed 2025-06-11T09:14:00Z. ingress-adaptive sample_rate=0.15, collector_drop_long=true.

marco: collector_drop_long=true smells like it's dropping long requests at the edge which would bias merged tdigest downward. but your rollup p99 increased?

elena: yeah weird direction. rollup p99 went up, raw host histograms stayed flat.

jordan: two hypotheses: (1) merge weights not applied correctly, causing shards with larger tails to dominate, (2) include_retries or dedup differences between rollup query vs endpoint breakdown.

priya: checking queries now. Rollup query in console was using include_retries=true to match legacy behavior; host breakdown endpoint view uses include_retries=false. that would make rollup look worse if retries are long.

elena: retries being included at aggregator but not in host-level view would definitely explain it. also if ingress downsampled short requests more than long ones, merge could amplify tail.

marco: quick repro: ran a recompute on raw events for a 30m window and got p99=820ms on raw samples, host histograms show ~480-520ms. console rollup shows 790ms. so rollup roughly matches raw samples when include_retries=true.

jordan: ok so we have mixed signals: raw recompute ~rollup, host histograms lower because they exclude retries. that's a config mismatch, not a math bug.

priya: mitigation: I'll switch the rollup to include_retries=false for the next 6h to get parity while we align semantics. we should also add a merge-proof audit: when tdigest merges happen, preserve per-shard sample counts and expose them.

elena: long-term: can we stop relying on merged tdigest for P99 and compute it from weighted raw quantiles when sample_count < threshold? tdigest is lossy for extremes when sketch sizes small.

marco: agree. suggestion: show a provenance pill on each quantile (tdigest-merged | recompute-raw | host-hist) and surface sample_count + sketch_size. makes triage immediate.

jordan: I'll file MET-2247 to add provenance and expose include_retries flag in UI for rollups.

metrics-bot: ticket MET-2247 "Latency quantile provenance + include_retries visibility" created and assigned to jordan.

elena: thanks. Priya, post the temporary config change and recompute numbers here once done and we can close the loop.

priya: switched rollup include_retries=false at 2025-06-11T09:42Z, recompute posted: raw-p99=515ms, host-hist-p99=520ms, rollup-now=518ms. alignment confirmed. will follow up with a proposal for merge-weight checks in the telemetry runbook.

jordan: perfect. follow-up items: doc merge semantics, UI provenance pill, alert when rollup/raw diverge >25% for p99.

elena: add a note to runbook about not downsampling long tails without preserving weighted sketches. simple bullet list will save time next time. :+1:
